risks.if_unproven: priced as unconfirmed region, treated as neutral/no premium

Screenshot of the game library showing the 10 installed games and FC26.
Close-up photo of the rear label/serial number on the console.
Photo of all accessories included (power cable, HDMI cable, box) laid out together.
Close-up of each controller's back panel and charging port.

choice.reason: The only comparable is for PS5 controllers/pads alone, not a PS5 console bundled with two controllers as described.

why: the model found no comparable that is the same item
